# ai-jury

> ai-jury convenes a cross-vendor, multi-agent code-review jury on a diff, PR, or
> issue and produces one report. Independent reviewers — Claude Code, Codex,
> Antigravity, a free local/open-weight model, and/or a hosted-API key (no CLI
> install needed) — each review, then cross-examine each other, verify findings,
> and reach a single verdict: either a chair's synthesis or a panel vote.
> Stdlib-only Python CLI, zero runtime dependencies, 100% test coverage.

## Docs

- [Home](https://berkayturanci.github.io/ai-jury/): overview, how the jury works, and quick start
- [Documentation](https://berkayturanci.github.io/ai-jury/docs.html): configuration, adapters, consensus modes, and CLI reference
- [Coverage report](https://berkayturanci.github.io/ai-jury/coverage.html): live test-coverage dashboard

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/berkayturanci/ai-jury): source, issues, and releases

## Key concepts

- Cross-vendor panel: each reviewer is a different model/vendor, reviewing independently
- Cross-examination: reviewers critique each other's findings before a verdict
- Verdict modes: chair's synthesis (one model reconciles) or panel vote (majority)
- Redaction and injection defenses for safe review of untrusted diffs
